#Moderation

a third variable affects strength of relationship between 2 other variables (outcome and predictor)

lm(outcome ~ predictor * moderator, data = dat)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
data(starwars)
```

## Does sex moderate relationship between height and mass?
```{r}
lm1 <- lm(mass ~ height * sex, data = starwars)
summary(lm1)
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggeffects)
a <- ggpredict(lm1, terms = c("sex"))
plot(a)
```
## Does birth year
```{r}
lm2 <- lm(mass ~ height * birth_year, data = starwars)
summary(lm2)
```
```{r}
b <- ggpredict(lm2)
plot(b)
```

```{r}
library(interactions)
interact_plot(lm2, pred = height, modx = birth_year)
```
#mediation
x and y are related through a third variable
```{r}
library(mediation)
```


Preacher and Hayes -
1) predict mediator from x - simple regression
2) predict y from x and mediator
